newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Conacex see exports growing 20 pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Conacex see exports growing 20 pct in '97.

text.p: The chairman of the National Foreign Trade Council (Conacex) estimated on Wednesday that exports will grow 20 percent in 1997 over this year because of a recovery in the economy.

"Mexican exports will grow 20 percent in 1997 and it is expected that a surplus will again be recorded in the trade balance," Gilberto Marin Cisneros said in an interview here in central Mexico. He said export projects will come on line next year bringing the additional foreign sales. Marin estimated exports this year will end at around $96 billion against the approximate $90 billion recorded in 1995.
